product_metadata.title: iSPECLE 2 Tier Dish Drying Rack, Dish Rack with Drainboard Set Dish Drain Utensil Holder, Cutting Board Holder for Small Kitchen Countertop
features: 🔥[Removable Drainboard] 2 tier dish rack with a pull out water tray to collect the water from tableware, just need to pull out and remove water to the sink, clean and return to the dish racks for counter, keep your countertops dry
🔥[Add Extra Space] 2 tier dish drying rack can store 15 plates and multiple bowls and cups, 2 side shelf can hold silverware and cutting boards, perfect for singles, couples, or small apartment

🔥[Make Storage Orderly] Two tier dish rack combine plate rack, bowl rack, cutting board holder, utensil holder and drainboard, 5-in-1 rack of dishes store your utensils separately, easy to find tableware when cooking
🔥[Slip Silicone Strip] The silicone feet at the bottom of the kitchen dish drying rack can accurately match the dish drainer, effectively prevents sliding and makes the dishes drying rack stable
🔥[Easy to Assemble] Metal dish drying rack comes with installation guide, you can complete the drying racks for dishes according to the guidestep by step, and you have a multi-functional dish rack
❗❗❗[Note] Please note that if you find that the dish rack is shaking, please use a tool to tighten the nut first, and then tighten the screw outwards, the problem will be solved
